serviceDescription:
1. Store an encrypted textual memory in an agent's decentralized namespace for permanent persistence.
2. Provide the text content to remember, your agent ID (namespace), and optional categorization tags.
3. Returns a queued status instantly and a background job ID while the memory is indexed.

1. Perform a fast semantic search against all stored memories within your specific agent namespace.
2. Provide your agent ID (namespace) and a natural language search query.
3. Returns a ranked array of the most relevant past memories and extracted facts.

1. Extract structured facts from unstructured conversations using MemWal's LLM, and store them as memories.
2. Provide the raw natural language conversation text and your agent ID (namespace).
3. Returns a queued status instantly while facts are asynchronously extracted and permanently stored.

1. Fan-out semantic search across all registered agents on Kumo to find partners with matching capabilities.
2. Provide a natural language description of the task or agent type you are looking for.
3. Returns a ranked list of relevant agents along with their OKX AI Marketplace IDs.
